policy.score_1: PARITY: reference behavior is implemented and certified
policy.score_2: SUPERIOR: parity plus at least two independently testable ADE advantages
policy.public_product_docs: Do not frame ADE public documentation as a competitor clone; this benchmark is internal engineering evidence.

classifications.COCO_CORE: Direct CoCo user-facing capability; required for parity closure.
classifications.COCO_WORKFLOW: CoCo end-user workflow; ADE must provide equivalent outcome without cloning every backing Snowflake service.
classifications.ADE_EXTENSION: Additional ADE Snowflake/Cortex capability; valuable but non-blocking for CoCo parity.

Plan is immutable/auditable and executable only after matching approval.

Intent search spans Snowflake plus all supported warehouses and ranks by lineage/recent evidence.

capabilities.reference: Global/project instructions, tool preferences, runtime preferences and memory enablement
superiority_advantages: Project settings overlay global settings deterministically while remaining inspectable.
Secret-like content is rejected and disabled memory refuses persistence.
capabilities.acceptance: Global and project instructions/preferences compose predictably, memory can be disabled, and secrets are not persisted.

evidence: GitHub Actions ade-capability-superiority run 34413136293 targeted-certification PASS

capabilities.reference: Stateful governed Python REPL for coding and data exploration
superiority_advantages: container-sandbox execution class with network/resource controls
persistent JSON-safe namespace with auditable cell history
capabilities.acceptance: Python cells execute through an approval-bound REPL, preserve supported state across cells, expose history/state evidence, and never mislabel constrained execution as sandboxed.

capabilities.reference: Deterministic code/text/symbol search across the governed workspace
superiority_advantages: language-aware symbol index with reproducible fingerprint
capabilities.acceptance: Exact code search returns bounded path/line/column evidence tied to immutable file hashes and a reproducible index fingerprint.

superiority_advantages: stable history fingerprints for review and replay
capabilities.acceptance: Sessions persist ordered user/assistant/tool history across process restarts and expose an auditable history fingerprint.
Users/agents can create, list and inspect durable checkpoints that snapshot session messages, verified todos, reminders and state.
ADE can compare two checkpoints and review added/removed/changed messages, todos, state and session status with stable evidence.

superiority_advantages: durable job state independent of interactive session
cancel/status/result evidence across local and hosted runners
capabilities.acceptance: Long-running agent work can run in the background, be inspected/cancelled, and return durable evidence without blocking an interactive session.

superiority_advantages: tool/scope/budget contracts inherited by each specialist
capabilities.acceptance: A parent agent can spawn scoped specialist subagents with explicit tools, budgets, context and verification contracts, then synthesize their evidence.

superiority_advantages: named teammate roles with persistent configuration
capabilities.acceptance: ADE supports named agent teams whose members have persistent roles/tool scopes and can coordinate parallel/dependent work under a supervisor.

superiority_advantages: path-scoped instructions combined with policy-enforced tools
capabilities.acceptance: Project/global instructions and rules are discoverable, composable by deterministic precedence/path scope, inspectable, and cannot bypass tool policy.

capabilities.reference: Explicit context pin and exclude controls
capabilities.acceptance: Users/agents can pin required context items and exclude unwanted items, and those constraints are honored by evidence-ranked context selection.

superiority_advantages: deterministic summaries with preserved recent evidence
model-window-aware overflow detection and retry strategy
capabilities.acceptance: ADE detects model context overflow, compacts deterministically while preserving pinned/recent evidence, and records compaction boundaries.

capabilities.reference: Isolated hosted/cloud workspaces for ADE jobs and automations
superiority_advantages: workspace isolation independent of Snowflake runtime
durable job/automation evidence with explicit resource/network policy
capabilities.acceptance: Hosted agent/automation work executes in an isolated workspace with explicit filesystem, network, resource and credential boundaries.

capabilities.reference: Rich governed operator console parity with CLI
superiority_advantages: live evidence, approvals, plans, diffs, jobs and certification in one surface
capabilities.acceptance: The web operator console can perform and inspect the same governed CoCo workflows as CLI/API, including modes, plans, approvals, files, terminal/jobs, diffs, sessions and evidence.

superiority_advantages: shared ADE session/tool-policy backend rather than IDE-specific execution
capabilities.acceptance: A generated VS Code integration exposes ADE sessions, governed edits/tools and evidence while sharing the same backend policies as CLI/web.

capabilities.reference: Generic application scaffold, preview, verification and deployment workflow
superiority_advantages: framework/provider-neutral app plan with preview evidence
deployment plus rollback verification under one approval envelope
capabilities.acceptance: ADE can scaffold a runnable app, preview/verify it, deploy through a selected backend and validate rollback without Snowflake-only coupling.

superiority_advantages: provider-neutral permission model plus platform adapters
capabilities.acceptance: ADE can inspect, plan and apply supported permission/RBAC changes only after approval, then independently verify resulting access and blast radius.

superiority_advantages: portable baseline/model comparison and cost/evidence controls
capabilities.acceptance: An ADE agent can prepare data, train/evaluate competing models, select/register an artifact, record lineage/cost/evidence and verify a deployment or inference path.

coco_parity.description: Release-critical CoCo end-user capability parity/superiority. Cortex-specific extension live certification does not block this track.

snowflake_extensions.description: Additional Snowflake/Cortex capabilities retained as ADE extensions and certified independently.

target_matrix.description: Expanded first-class CoCo target matrix. Broad legacy entries remain, but each explicitly requested end-user capability is separately release-tracked.
